releaseNotes:
Release v0.20.1

Bug Fixes:
- Stabilize graph JSON serialization: one shared serializer, sorted keys, stable node/edge order (PS-267)
- Track real node movement instead of click/drag-end events so selection no longer dirties an unchanged graph (PS-267)
- Preserve graph dirty state across async parameter, expression and expose/unexpose edits (PS-267)
- Keep unchanged file and folder picker defaults clean; cancelled dialogs no longer dirty the graph (PS-267)
- Track confirmed backend data across overlapping Apply/Save edits so reversions are not lost (PS-267)
- Preserve typed reversions in text, numeric and path fields while earlier writes are pending (PS-267)
- Exposed enum parameters in Tools use the shared styled dropdown with keyboard navigation (PS-267)

Improvements:
- Guide updates: menu reference, tools, working with nodes
